propositions: Bridge fsck reported four unbound Jira issues (REB-806, REB-807, REB-808, and one additional) with missing forward/reverse binding-store entries despite exact identity match between local code_review artifacts and live Jira issues
Three Jira issues had identical rebar-id labels, titles, revisions, PASS decisions, and fingerprints to existing local code_review tickets but lacked bidirectional binding mappings

Binding repair procedure restored all three forward/reverse mappings atomically under the rebar write lock using BindingStore.bind_confirm and persisted through commit_and_push_tickets_branch with strict mode
Post-repair bridge fsck verified no alerting binding-drift, store-integrity, or unknown-event-type findings remained and all six forward/reverse binding lookups resolved correctly
